business: Nota (@NotaGetBot): a Telegram bot that collects receipts, invoices and handwritten delivery notes from work chats into a Google Sheet and flags duplicates and arithmetic errors
by_segment: Company-registration / PT PMA service that also does monthly bookkeeping
why_not: I'd use the 40 free documents by forwarding receipts to it myself, but I wouldn't pay yet: I still have to retype everything into Jurnal, and it doesn't make my clients send receipts any earlier. A Google Sheet is just one more place to copy from.

I have 20 clients and one account takes only 5 groups and one sheet, so I would be juggling four Google logins and still typing everything into Jurnal myself. I might burn the 40 free documents on one client to see how it reads handwritten nota, but I would not pay for it this month.

My clients send me their receipts on WhatsApp, not Telegram, and that routine works for me. I'm not going to ask villa owners and shop staff to move to a new app just so I can use a bot, and $19 a month is a real cost on what I earn.

My clients already send me their nota on WhatsApp, and I'm not going to ask villa staff and café cashiers to move to a Telegram group just for me. The month-end pile is annoying, but my routine works and it costs me nothing.

I make about a thousand dollars a month, and $19 to $45 every month is real money when my clients pay me a flat fee no matter how many receipts they send. I might play with the 40 free documents, but I'd go back to chasing receipts by hand before I'd start paying.

I earn maybe $1,800 a month, and my clients will not pay extra for this, so $19 or $45 comes straight out of my pocket. My clients also hand me a bag of crumpled nota at month end, not Telegram photos, so I would still be photographing everything myself and then retyping it into Jurnal.

I am not putting my clients' receipts and bank screenshots into an unknown Telegram bot when I cannot tell who runs it or where the data is processed under UU PDP. And even if I did, without invoice number, PPN and NPWP fields or an export to Jurnal or Accurate, my staff would still retype everything.

I bill by the hour, so sorting receipts is time I get paid for, and if the bot misreads a handwritten nota I still have to check every row because my name is on the books. Maybe I would try the free 40 documents on one client, but I would not pay yet.

I have 20 clients and the cap is 5 groups per account, so I'd be juggling four Google logins just to keep clients apart. On top of that, I'm not putting client receipts through a Telegram bot I've never heard of until I know where the data goes and that it's UU PDP-compliant.

I'd probably throw one messy client at the free 40 documents to see if it really reads the Indonesian nota, but I won't pay for something capped at 5 groups when I have 20 clients. Juggling four Google accounts and four subscriptions just to keep clients separate is more admin, not less.
